title: On an iPhone the welcome would offer Continue with Google but no Sign in with Apple
what: The welcome screen shows Continue with Google whenever this build can sign in or look in Google Drive. Nothing checks for an iPhone, and the app has no Sign in with Apple at all. Apple's review rules ask an app that offers a sign-in through another company to also offer one that keeps the email private, so an iPhone build would be refused as it stands.
expected: When the iPhone app ships, the welcome offers Sign in with Apple (or an equal private way) next to Google, or hides Google sign-in on iPhone.
fix_line: Add Sign in with Apple to the welcome and account screens before the iPhone release, or hide Google sign-in there

items.reason: No fault in this area: no permission is asked here, intro and welcome words make no health or body-result claim, 18+ and terms box comes before phone and Google sign-in, the proven number is not stored in the profile, phone number and body weight are never copied to the account, account delete and erase all data exist, Play shows no policy issue. The Play data safety form itself is not in the machine file, so it was not compared line by line; Wear OS and WhatsApp sending are not in this area.

Fonts are open-licence and credited; the seed exercise list is words only (its pictures live in the tracker catalog, outside this area). The gym's uploaded logo shown across the app is the existing finding FN-L12-panel-brand-shell-01. Whether the MettleUp name and logo are registered cannot be seen in code.
